title: Media Dispatch Protocol (MDP) — Protocol Specification
scope: This standard defines the message set, data structures and data dictionary of the Media Dispatch Protocol (MDP) for orchestrating the transfer of files across IP networks. The standard also specifies requirements on mapping specifications that define representations of the messages and data structures. The standard also defines requirements on profile specifications that define subsets of the protocol and rules on the use of those subsets.
